## Outreach

* Winners' annoucement announcement's [slides](media/PRC_Data_Challenge_2026.pdf)
  at [14th OpenSky Symposium][osnsym], hosted by [CRIDA][crida], Madrid, Spain.
* LinkedIn post by EUROCONTROL on PRC Data Challenge outcome (beg Nov)
* All shared repos from participating teams on [PRC Data Challenge 2026 GitHub organization][dc2026org]
* PRC Data Challenge data
   - JOAD data paper describing the dataset of the challenge (< end of Q1 2027)
   - pubblication of dataset of the challenge as open data (simultaneously with data paper)
* acceptance and review of JOAS papers from teams willing to describe their model (Q1 2027)
